name: white-christmas-confidence-resilience
objective: Minimize avoidable unavailability while preserving honest uncertainty and spatial representativeness.
hard_vetoes: West Branch, Michigan returns unavailable under normal source availability while multiple usable regional Christmas snow-depth records exist.
Regional blending is presented as an exact local observation.
A single upstream failure destroys an otherwise usable historical estimate.
The UI assumes a regional blend always has one station and crashes.
Confidence rises without regard to historical evidence quality.
scenarios: ACIS temporary failure with cached last-known-good baseline
CPC outage with historical estimate intact
snowpack outage outside and inside 45 days
